question: Acidic drain cleaners made of ________ or ________ acid are powerful enough to clear heavy-duty hair, food, grease, soap scum, or paper-based clogs in 15 minutes or less.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sulphuric, or hydrochloric**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acid drain cleaners** commonly contain a **high concentration **of** sulfuric acid(H₂SO₄) or hydrochloric (HCL) acid,** and typically come in** liquid form**.
 
• They work by a process of acid hydrolysis to dissolve the fats and solids that create a drain blockage.
 
• Acid hydrolysis is the process of breaking down larger molecules into smaller molecules by adding acid and water to a substance.
 
• They work well on hair and grease, and they can dissolve small pieces of paper and other solids in the drain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are four basic types of chemical drain cleaners: **acid, caustic, oxidizing, and enzymatic**.
